describe.description: Discover your wallet, network, available operations and limits. Does not create a wallet.

balance.description: Read native spendable balance; pending execution is reported separately. Amounts are integer base-unit strings.

assets.description: List host-configured contract recipes and assets. This is not an exhaustive token index.

read.description: Read a host-configured EVM or intelligent-contract view.

prepare.description: Simulate an allowed EVM action and save an expiring, wallet-bound proposal. Does not sign or send.

submit.description: Submit exactly one prepared proposal. Repeated submission returns the existing execution; never create another to retry a timeout.

status.description: Reconcile a proposal against canonical receipts and configured confirmations. Unknown submissions remain pending.
